title: First Observer
next_chapter_hook: In the instant the Turtle Shell divine artifact emitted its gentle radiance, Chen Ji sensed a fundamental transformation in his connection with the Tianji Record—a key capable of overturning the entire cultivation world's landscape.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's fingertip touched the fragment, an ancient yet familiar aura rushed toward him—power from the same source as the Tianji Record, yet more complete, more terrifying. As light swirled, a figure materialized from the Void, an elderly man with white hair, surrounded by countless tiny points of light like an inverted galaxy hanging at his side.

dialogue.content: You have finally arrived.
(His pupils contract slightly, yet quickly return to calm) Who are you?

text.content: The old man smiled faintly, that smile carrying the vicissitudes and weariness of ten thousand years. His form was not tall, yet it seemed to bear the weight of all heaven and earth. Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure descend upon him, surpassing any powerful individual he had ever known—even Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, would be but firefly before the bright moon compared to this pressure.

dialogue.content: Who am I? I am the first to see Heavenly Secrets, and the first to attempt defying Heavenly Fate. For ten thousand years, I have awaited you—my descendant.

Descendant? (Cold laugh) The descendant you speak of is merely a poor pawn chosen by you to be a chess piece? The Tianji Record Fragment, Heavenly Fate Values, the Observer System—this is all merely a scheme you have laid out.

text.content: The old man did not become angry; instead, a trace of relieved joy appeared on his face. He waved his hand, and the surrounding space transformed abruptly. Chen Ji found himself standing within a vast sea of stars. Countless points of light flowed around him, like dust in the river of time, each speck reflecting an image—the fates of countless Observers, countless moments when Heavenly Secrets were revealed.

dialogue.content: What do you see?
(Gazing at the points of light) Countless figures... and my own past. Every future I have glimpsed has left its trace here.

text.content: Ten thousand years ago, I was also among them.

dialogue.content: The old man waved his hand, and those points of light suddenly gathered, forming a massive mirror before Chen Ji. Within the mirror reflected a youthful figure—a young man whose features bore some resemblance to Chen Ji, standing atop a towering mountain peak, overlooking the myriad beings beneath his feet.

text.content: That is... me? Chen Ji gazed at the figure in the mirror, an inexplicable sensation rising in his heart. Though the young man's face differed from his own, that aura, that calculative gaze that overlooked everything, seemed like another version of himself from a different timeline.

dialogue.content: The first generation Observer, and the only one who successfully glimpsed the complete Heavenly Secrets. He saw what should not be seen, and thus had his physical body erased by Heavenly Dao, leaving only a wisp of remnant soul to guard the first page of the Tianji Record—which you call Mo Xiansheng.
Mo Xiansheng... is actually the remnant soul of the first generation Observer? Then who are you?

text.content: The old man fell silent for a moment, the points of light around him trembling slightly. He slowly raised his right hand, and a drop of crystalline blood appeared in his palm—that blood emanated exactly the same aura as Chen Ji's own bloodline, yet a thousand times more concentrated.

dialogue.content: I am his inheritor, and the creator of the Observer System. Ten thousand years ago, the remnant soul of the first generation Observer split the Tianji Record into countless fragments, scattering them throughout the world, awaiting the next person qualified to inherit it. And I... am merely a vessel chosen by that remnant soul.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his mind explode. Those scattered fragments of memory now assembled into a complete picture—the selection by the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng's subtle hints, and that inexplicable familiarity each time he used the Tianji Record... everything pointed to a truth he had never imagined.

dialogue.content: So... my bloodline exists because of that drop of essence blood merged with Observer power from back then?

Not merely merging. The old man extended his finger, gently touching Chen Ji's Brow Center. A warm force instantly flooded into his body, like rain after a long drought. Chen Ji clearly felt something long dormant within him awakening—that was the bloodline imprint left by the first generation Observer, and the fundamental reason he could bear the Tianji Record.

text.content: The old man withdrew his finger, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. He gazed at Chen Ji as if looking at a long-lost relative. Ten thousand years of waiting, ten thousand years of scheming, countless Observers like chess pieces being selected, eliminated, consumed—all sacrifices and calculations, for the arrival of this moment.

choice.prompt: Facing the truth of his origins and the heavy mission of the Observer System, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Accept the First Observer's legacy, continue the Observer System, and walk the predetermined path.
choices.visible_cost: Lose free will and become the next chess piece manipulated by the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete power of the Tianji Record and all the memories of the First Observer
choices.risk_hint: May completely degenerate into a puppet of the Heavenly Dao
choices.process_label: 感受血脉中涌动的力量

dialogue.content: (Slowly closes his eyes, feeling the surging power within his body) I understand. Since this path must be walked by me, I shall walk it. But I will do it my own way.

text.content: Upon hearing this, a gleam of approval flickered in the old man's eyes. The inheritance of the First Observer rushed into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—that was a vast knowledge he had never imagined—accumulated over ten thousand years, countless observers' experiences and lessons, and the supreme technique capable of glimpsing the Heavenly Secrets.

choices.description: Refuse to become the next Observer, break the shackles of fate in his own way, and forge a new path.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the conveniences and protections brought by the Observer system
choices.visible_reward: Escape the control of the Heavenly Dao's will and obtain true freedom
choices.risk_hint: May become an enemy of the entire Heavenly Dao
choices.process_label: 感受血脉中觉醒的力量

dialogue.content: (Opens his eyes abruptly, a flash of defiance burning in his gaze) Enough! I am no one's chess piece, nor any continuation of fate. The Tianji Record is my tool, not my chain!

text.content: An astonishing aura suddenly erupted from within Chen Ji, a power surpassing all previous observers' inheritances. The remnants of the First Observer seemed to sense his resolve, forming a pale golden light barrier around him that completely shielded him from the old man's pressure.

choices.description: Neither blindly accept nor blindly reject, but examine all truths and flaws from a bystander's perspective.
choices.visible_cost: May touch upon certain forbidden truths
choices.visible_reward: Gain understanding beyond the Observer's perspective and discover hidden secrets
choices.process_label: 感受血脉中涌动的力量

dialogue.content: (A cold smile curves his lips) You claim to be the successor? Then why has Mo Xiansheng never mentioned you? What connection do you have to this 'Heavenly Dao's will' you speak of?

text.content: A strange glint flickered in the old man's eyes—a subtle expression of being struck at a vital point. He fell silent for a moment, and the starlight specks around him trembled slightly, as if pulled by some invisible force.

dialogue.content: Good, very good. A tremor carried in the old man's voice—an expectation that ten thousand years could not erase. Whatever choice you make, I will pass this Turtle Shell divine artifact to you. It is the core of the Tianji Record and the treasure that all previous observers yearned for.

text.content: Once more, a drop of crystal-clear blood appeared in the old man's palm, but different from before—this time the power within it was more fierce, more primal. It drifted slowly toward Chen Ji, resonating with the awakened bloodline in his body. An excruciating pain surged from the depths of his soul, and Chen Ji felt his Mental Sea being torn apart yet simultaneously reshaped.

dialogue.content: This is... the First Observer's inheritance? No, there's something else here! Chen Ji suddenly realized, a flash of shock and fury in his eyes. Within that blood not only lay the power of an Observer, but also hidden—a extremely covert consciousness—that was the mark of the Heavenly Dao's Eye!

text.content: The old man—or rather, the successor of the First Observer—took a slow step back, a complex smile appearing on his face. That smile held guilt, helplessness, but more than anything, a relief of liberation. Ten thousand years of scheming, and finally the time for harvest had arrived.

dialogue.content: Do you think I wanted this? The old man's voice suddenly became aged and weary. Ten thousand years ago, I too was like you, attempting to resist the Heavenly Dao's manipulation. But in the end, I discovered I was merely another chess piece in an even grander game. The Heavenly Dao's Eye never disappeared—it simply found another way to persist—through the inheritance between Observers, continuing from generation to generation.

text.content: Chen Ji felt that mark of the Heavenly Dao within him was frantically eroding his Mental Sea—a control more terrifying than any prohibition. Once fully merged, he would become the next puppet manipulated by the Heavenly Dao, forever unable to break free from the shackles of fate.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Dao imprint merging within his body, Chen Ji had to make an immediate decision:

choices.description: To counter the erosion of the Heavenly Dao imprint with his own will, suppressing it through the bloodline power of the First Observer.
choices.visible_cost: Risk suffering Heavenly Dao backlash and losing a significant amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete self-awareness, free from control by any power
choices.risk_hint: Risk completely infuriating the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.process_label: 感受到灵魂被撕裂的痛苦

dialogue.content: (Gritting his teeth, golden light blazing around him) You want to control me? You're not qualified!

text.content: An unprecedented power erupted from within Chen Ji—the most primal rebellious will residing in the First Observer's bloodline. The Heavenly Dao imprint shrieked piercingly under this force's impact, yet could advance no further.

choices.description: Neither resisting nor merging, but using the power of the Tianji Record to trace the imprint's origin backward, turning it to his own use.
choices.visible_cost: Risk permanently retaining the hidden danger of the Heavenly Dao imprint
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability to trace back to the true form of the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Risk being traced back by the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.process_label: 感受天机录与烙印的共鸣

dialogue.content: (A gleam flickering in his eyes) Since you want to control me, I'll follow you, tracing this thread to find your true form.

text.content: Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, treating the Heavenly Dao imprint as an invisible thread, beginning to trace it backward. What it connected to was none other than the ultimate existence hidden behind the Heavenly Dao—the true body of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

choices.description: Temporarily release resistance, allowing the Heavenly Dao imprint to completely merge into the Mental Sea, retreating strategically to gain full power.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete memory and power inheritance of the First Observer
choices.risk_hint: Risk permanently losing part of oneself
choices.process_label: 感受灵魂被填满的充实感

dialogue.content: (Closing his eyes in brief contemplation) Very well, I accept your inheritance. But I will find a way to break free from your control.

text.content: The Heavenly Dao imprint surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide, slowly merging with his consciousness. That sensation was both like being filled and being emptied. He could clearly perceive the First Observer's ten thousand years of memories becoming part of him—including those deliberately hidden secrets.

In the instant the merging was about to complete, Chen Ji sensed something. His gaze pierced through layers of starry seas, landing on a hidden corner behind the old man—where an extremely faint consciousness fluctuation lay concealed, bearing the exact same yet subtly different aura as the Heavenly Dao's Eye. The First Observer, the true First Observer—he had never truly perished, but had been waiting for something all along.

dialogue.content: (A meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips) So that's how it is. Is this your true purpose?

text.content: The old man's expression shifted abruptly, the starry light particles around him exploding outward. His gaze at Chen Ji was no longer the benevolence of an elder looking upon a junior, but rather as if looking at a monster—a monster that should not exist in this world. His ten thousand-year scheme, his meticulously designed inheritance, his supposedly perfect plan—all of it became a joke before this young man.

dialogue.content: "You... how could you possibly have discovered this!"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer, merely raising his hand as a streak of golden light condensed within his palm. This was the complete power of the Tianji Record, an existence that transcended all Observers. He saw the truth behind the old man—there lay the true soul fragment of the First Observer, while the old man before him was merely a puppet controlled by that fragment. Ten thousand years ago, the First Observer foresaw his own death, thus hiding his true consciousness deep within the Tianji Record, awaiting the next person capable of bearing his full power. And Chen Ji was precisely that person.

dialogue.content: "You wished to use me for resurrection, yet never imagined I would discover your existence." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "Since you are merely a remnant will of the First Observer, you should understand this better—I am never anyone's chess piece."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a subtle transformation occurring within his power. The Heavenly Mandate imprint injected by the old man had begun resonating with the Tianji Record. He glimpsed an unprecedented possibility—if he could completely fuse the Heavenly Mandate imprint with the Tianji Record, he might acquire the ability to directly converse with the Heavenly Eye.

At that moment, the hidden remnant finally revealed itself. A illusory figure drifted forth from the depths of the starry sea—a youth bearing seven or eight tenths resemblance to Chen Ji himself—the true visage of the First Observer. He gazed at Chen Ji, his eyes filled with complex emotions. Ten thousand years of waiting, ten thousand years of scheming, finally bringing forth a descendant capable of bearing everything. Yet this descendant proved more powerful and more dangerous than imagined. The First Observer's remnant slowly spoke, his voice carrying the weight of ten thousand years of vicissitudes and a trace of relief.

dialogue.content: "You have won."

text.content: In the instant the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact radiated its gentle glow, Chen Ji sensed a fundamental shift occurring in his connection with the Tianji Record—a key capable of overturning the entire cultivation world's landscape. The old man—or rather, the true remnant of the First Observer behind him—handed over control of the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact to Chen Ji, signifying that from this moment forth, the complete form of the Tianji Record would fully merge with Chen Ji.
